name: oracle
notes: A CONTROL, NOT A HARNESS. It runs the dataset's own reference solution instead of attempting the task, and exists to prove that a dataset's verify path can produce a pass at all. A score of 0 from a real harness against a dataset whose oracle also scores 0 says nothing about the harness -- it says the check is not reachable, which is exactly the ambiguity this control removes. Never report a curve row for it.
